title: DKA 4 of 7, step-down / telemetry: type 1 diabetes in DKA with acute kidney injury on CKD G3b (3 days, checkpoints every 0700 and 1900)
diagnosis: Diabetic ketoacidosis (glucose 620, pH 7.22, bicarbonate 10, anion gap 25, BHB 7.2) after insulin omission during a viral illness, with stage 1 acute kidney injury on CKD G3b from repaired congenital posterior urethral valves; cautious fluids, careful potassium, renal dosing and sick-day teaching
desc: Thu 11/05 0700 to Sun 11/08 0700. A 31-year-old with type 1 diabetes and kidney disease from birth arrives in DKA with AKI; care needs small fluids, careful potassium and a kidney-safe plan. Vital signs after 0700 come from the bedside monitor.
